I spent way more time painstakingly scrutinizing every pixel of this than I probably should have.
But it's only my second pixelsmithing project, and I'm really happy with the final result.

[color=#6aa84f]I did see that paritee [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3350]has already done a John Deere reskin[/url],
 But that mod is only a recolouring of the original tractor model, to a Deere green/yellow pallet.[/color][/color][color=#ffff00]
[/color]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/mgZWPjKf/Header.png[/img]
[color=#ffff00]I thought my idea of having the idle animation as, like; little blinking parking lights, was a nice immersive touch.
But it is quite erratic on when it decides to blink, particularly when facing the tractor north.
I don't have any control over this activation.

[color=#6aa84f]If you really don't like the effect, you can disable it within the config.json and change the "On" text to "Off"
You can now also do this in game using the 'Generic Mod Configuration Menu' mod.
